summary: Repair the custom projection dirty-work hint regression introduced by #5690: invalidating an already queued subject must still wake the current writer's custom finalizer.

replay.detail: Custom and notice dirty-queue UPSERT conflicts now issue an intentional no-op subject UPDATE, invoking the connection-local UPDATE notifier even when another connection queued the subject first. Replica-record custom.* lifecycle changes also wake the custom finalizer.

schema.detail: Replace existing durable dirty-queue invalidation trigger definitions; no claim shape or database table change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or preparation-fence allowlist change.

compatibility.detail: Fixes the connection-local hint introduced by commit 392c872af22c0f27aaf546e6be2584bb3c1f89f0 in #5690. It can otherwise leave registered custom subjects and native notice projections showing old fields, attention and ready health after queued changes or repairs. Version 0.3.30 predates the hint; the 0.3.31 candidate includes it.

downtime.detail: No fleet coordination or claim migration; trigger definitions refresh when the store opens.

manual.detail: No operator migration. Store open drains durable custom dirty work.

recovery.detail: Do not revert to the broken connection-local hint implementation while durable custom invalidations can be written by another connection.
